description: A transparent 0-100 risk score for a wallet with named reasons and the evidence behind each: issuer block-list membership, tokens the wallet minted that are now rated danger, flagged tokens it bought (tokens merely sent to it never count), round trips with itself, bot-like trading, a very new wallet. `notChecked` lists what was not scored (mixers and sanctions lists, scam-labelled counterparties). It is a heuristic, not an accusation: quote `disclaimer` with the score and never present it as proof of wrongdoing. Wallets without a stake key get no score.
name: get_wallet_risk
title: Wallet risk score (a heuristic)
